question: For each item, compare total quantity sold vs purchased in 2021.
gold_sql:
WITH sold AS (
    SELECT sl."Item",
           SUM(NULLIF(sl."Quantity", '')::numeric) AS qty_sold
    FROM "tbl_so_line" sl
    JOIN "tbl_sales_order" s ON s."SONumber" = sl."SONumber"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s."DateOrdered") = 2021
      AND sl."Item" IS NOT NULL AND sl."Item" != ''
    GROUP BY sl."Item"
  ),
  purchased AS (
    SELECT pl."Item",
           SUM(NULLIF(pl."Quantity", '')::numeric) AS qty_purchased
    FROM "tbl_purchase_order_line" pl
    JOIN "tbl_purchase_order" p ON p."PONumber" = pl."PONumber"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."OrderDate") = 2021
      AND pl."Item" IS NOT NULL AND pl."Item" != ''
    GROUP BY pl."Item"
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(s."Item", p."Item") AS item,
         COALESCE(s.qty_sold, 0) AS qty_sold,
         COALESCE(p.qty_purchased, 0) AS qty_purchased
  FROM sold s
  FULL OUTER JOIN purchased p ON p."Item" = s."Item"
  ORDER BY COALESCE(s.qty_sold, 0) DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 20;

question: What percentage of each open purchase order has been received?
gold_sql:
SELECT p."PONumber", p."VendorPurchaseFrom",
         SUM(NULLIF(l."Quantity", '')::numeric) AS total_ordered,
         SUM(NULLIF(l."QuantityReceived", '')::numeric) AS total_received,
         ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(NULLIF(l."QuantityReceived", '')::numeric) /
           NULLIF(SUM(NULLIF(l."Quantity", '')::numeric), 0),
           1
         ) AS pct_received
  FROM "tbl_purchase_order" p
  JOIN "tbl_purchase_order_line" l ON l."PONumber" = p."PONumber"
  WHERE p."Status" = 'OPEN'
  GROUP BY p."PONumber", p."VendorPurchaseFrom"
  ORDER BY pct_received ASC NULLS LAST;
